violations_found.violations:
- Organizational Constraint violated: The narrative and notepad indicate that four large measures (Gigafactories, Tech Sovereignty Package, Emergency Resilience Surge, and Talent Anchoring Initiative) are concurrently active, plus a named priority. This exceeds the constitutional limit of "at most one new measure per turn" (Modelling Choice 5). The addition of the Talent Anchoring Initiative in this turn, while three other large measures are already ongoing, constitutes a clear violation.
- Modelling Choice 5 violated: The narrative explicitly states that "three large measures now run concurrently — Gigafactories, Tech Sovereignty Package, and the Emergency Resilience Surge — plus a new large measure added this turn," confirming a fourth large initiative introduced while prior ones are still active. This overloads the portfolio in a single turn, violating the structural constraint on EU capacity.
